subject: SIG: Third-Party Service Registry — clarifications and evidence
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@quantumhealth.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@quantumhealth.io
Date: 2026-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG Questionnaire — latest subprocessor/service registry needed

Hi Tessa,

We're working through the SIG for QuantumHealth and noticed the subprocessor/service registry in the questionnaire is out of date. For our evaluation team we need a CSV (or spreadsheet) with the following columns: vendor name, service provided (e.g., cloud compute, telemetry/monitoring, support/chat), data classes processed (PHI/PII/Non-sensitive), data flow direction, primary region(s), contract owner, certificate/evidence (SOC2/SOC3/ISO/etc), and whether telemetry/troubleshooting logs are exported to third parties.

Can you send an updated registry and any supporting evidence (SOC2 attestation or links) by end of day Friday (2026-09-18)? If some vendors require redaction for contractual reasons, flag those and provide contact points so we can validate with the vendor directly.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that's easier — are you available tomorrow morning?

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Security Programs Manager
QuantumHealth
laura.chen@quantumhealth.io

Attachments: none

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@quantumhealth.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire — latest subprocessor/service registry needed

Laura — thanks for the heads up and the template fields. We're on it. Two quick clarifications so we return exactly what you need:

- For "data classes processed": do you need PHI vs PII broken out per vendor, or is a single high-level tag (PHI/PII/Other) sufficient?
- For "telemetry exported to third parties": should we list only external vendors (e.g., Splunk, HoneyComb) or also internal telemetry sinks (e.g., our internal observability pipeline) for completeness?

Karthik (sales ops) and Neha (security/compliance) are looped in — Karthik will assemble the services inventory, Neha will add the controls/evidence column and flag anything contractually sensitive.

I can do a quick call tomorrow 9:30–10:00am PT if that works; otherwise we'll aim to deliver a compiled CSV by 9/17 and the full packet (registry + cover letter + evidence links) by 9/18 EOD.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales — Security & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0134

Attachments: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG Questionnaire — latest subprocessor/service registry needed

Tessa — starting the export now. Attached is a preliminary CSV extract (redwood_subprocessors_20260914.csv) with:
- Core cloud (CloudOpsX) — compute / data storage / key management — processes customer tensors and metadata (PII flag on account metadata), primary region: us-west-2 — SOC2 Type II (link to attestations in column)
- Telemetry/observability: Splunk, internal observability pipeline (Redwood Telemetry), HoneyComb (limited) — indicate which vendors receive aggregated logs vs raw traces
- Support tooling: SupportFlow (ticketing), Intercom (chat) — data classes: support transcripts (PII in usernames, optional attachments)

I've also attached a small architecture diagram of our telemetry path (k8s_telemetry_diagram.png) to help the review team understand what leaves our cluster vs retained in our region. Neha — can you add any vendor-level evidence strings and flag vendors we should redact or provide contact for?

Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_20260914.csv, k8s_telemetry_diagram.png

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@quantumhealth.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, sig@thirdparty-audit.com
Date: 2026-09-17T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG — compiled third-party registry and supporting evidence (QuantumHealth)

Laura — attaching the compiled registry and a short cover letter for QuantumHealth. Per our internal review, we included all external vendors that regularly receive telemetry or customer troubleshooting data and annotated the CSV with the evidence we can share. A few notes:

- CloudOpsX: SOC2 Type II available; provided link and point of contact in the evidence column. We cannot share the full subprocessors appendix from CloudOpsX agreement but have provided their compliance portal link and attestation date.
- Splunk / HoneyComb: Splunk receives aggregated logs; HoneyComb receives traces for some debug sessions only and only when customers opt in.
- SupportFlow: ticket exports to third-party analytics vendor (VendorAnalytica) — VendorAnalytica is listed and flagged; we provided the contract owner and approximate retention window.
- Redactions: 2 vendor contact emails redacted for contract reasons; redaction reasons are in the "notes" column and we listed vendor contacts for direct validation.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_registry_QH_20260917.csv, sig_cover_letter_QH_20260917.pdf

For your convenience I also uploaded the packet to a shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDriveLink/subprocessor-evidence

If you need SOC2 PDFs for any specific vendor, flag which ones and we'll request vendor evidence. Happy to join a quick call if any items need lining up.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales — Security & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Tessa — received, thanks for the fast turnaround and the helpful notes. A couple quick follow-ups before we close the SIG:

1) For CloudOpsX, can you confirm the telemetry retention window for aggregated logs that leave Redwood, and whether those logs may include customer identifiers (user IDs/email hashes)? If there is a specific paragraph in CloudOpsX's SOC2 or data processing agreement we can cite, that would speed our review.

2) Can you provide (or ask CloudOpsX for) the SOC2 PDF or an attestation link for their latest report? The portal link in your CSV is helpful but we also need a dated attestation for our records.

If you can provide those two items by EOD Monday we'll close the subprocessor section of our SIG. Appreciate the thoroughness.

Regards,
Laura Chen
Security Programs Manager
QuantumHealth
